review:
Le Clubber puts Smokey the raccoon in charge of a nightclub in Hacksaw's Le series. It is a cluster game where winning positions become Marked Squares; a Rainbow symbol activates them to reveal Coins, Buckets of Gold and Four-Leaf Clovers that boost coin values.

Three or more FS symbols trigger the bonus games, where Marked Squares build up across spins and give the Rainbow more to work with. Hacksaw publishes 3/5 volatility, a 10,000x max win and RTP versions of 96.34%, 94.23% and 92.17%. It suits players who already like Le Bandit's square-and-rainbow mechanic and want it with a new theme.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 92.17% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
